form:FormGroup.label: Max Store Size
form:FormGroup.helpText: How big this store's data file may grow. Writes fail once it is full, so leave some headroom. Only increases take effect: the data file never shrinks, because space freed by retention is reused rather than returned to the disk. Lowering this below the file's current size therefore reclaims nothing - the store keeps the size it has already reached and simply stops accepting new data, failing every write as full while the data already in it stays readable. Raising the value again restores writing.

form:FormGroup.label: Synchronise Data Merges On Write
form:FormGroup.helpText: When writing data, should processors wait until data is fully merged into Plan B shards before marking stream processing as complete.

form:FormGroup.label: Overwrite Existing Data
form:FormGroup.helpText: If subsequent data that is loaded matches an existing key then should the existing be kept or overwritten? By default Plan B will overwrite existing data.
